plainTranslation: Their Saturn in your 7th house: serious, committed, durable - they show up as a long-term partner. Built to last, or built to restrict. Failure mode: commitment that curdles into control or obligation. Strong for the long haul; watch that loyalty doesn't become a cage.
policy: Governed by synastry-policy. Descriptive, not deterministic; intensity is never treated as obligation, safety concerns override astrology.
note: Imported from approved project marquee synastry house overlay material. Source file was not copied into the repository.
